children: The difficult question for central banks is how much tightening the market has already done for them, Ken Egan, senior director for sovereigns at KBRA says in a note. "Yields are already high enough to bite into mortgages, corporate borrowing, and investment," he says. Therefore, the market is weighing whether much more policy tightening is actually needed, he says.(emese.bartha@wsj.com)
